title: Strict scalar composition associators and proper/open factor equations
statement: For finite coefficient field inclusions E → F → L: the constant coefficient maps compose; the ordinary, derived-base, whole-tower and strict derived-tower tensor associators and the completed tensor associator are the canonical composite-adjunction comparisons; arithmetic selection of levels e then h is selection of level h*e, and the ramification indices multiply. The strict proper scalar mates compose under the strict tower associator (compositionProper), and so do the open balancing maps (compositionOpen).

source.place: Tags 07A6, 0E8I and 0941; auxiliary strict scalar composition calculations preceding support realization.

proof.text: Unfold constantMap, rewrite composition of the underlying functor maps, and use extensionality of the composed algebra homomorphisms. The ramification equality follows from Ideal.map_map and Ideal.map_pow; the selection identity from e*(n+1)-1+1=e*(n+1) and subsingleton arrows; the associators are defined as leftAdjointUniq and localized whiskerings.

compositionProper: the strict tower associator is the composite-adjunction comparison (scalarTowerAssociator_normalization). Invert the proved proper-restriction cocycle (properRestriction_composition) and apply mateEquiv_hcomp with the two conjugate/mate pasting identities.

compositionOpen: apply ordinaryBaseOpenTensor_composition at each index of an ordinary strict tower, conclude by natural-transformation extensionality, and carry the equation through exact localization by the localized open-tensor composition helper of the same module.

proof_origin.place: Auxiliary strict scalar composition calculations extracted to keep the item module within the compile limit.
